d.t: EDGE PROFILE FOR CONTAINMENT AND SEGMENTING OF LANDSCAPE FEATURES
d.s: SikaRoof VersiEdge P is a high strength edge profile designed to retain and frame vegetated roof gardens. The edge profile is manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and is used to separate planting media and aggregates from other materials in the rooftop area. SikaRoof VersiEdge P has a L-shaped design to utilise the weight of the green roof build-up to keep the barrier in place allowing the zoning of different elements in rooftop gardens.
a: Partition and edge profile for landscape roofs
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Edge profile and aggregate partition for landscape roofs.
